name: NASN Intelligent Tech (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
summary: NASN Intelligent Tech (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2016 and headquartered in Shanghai, develops, makes and sells driving motion control technology in China, Southeast Asia and South America. Its products include the NBC integrated intelligent braking system, ESC stability control, the NBooster braking assist, a drive-by-wire chassis for L3/L4 and the DP-EPS steer-by-wire system. It also develops software algorithms for brake control. It was formerly Shanghai NASN Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd.
